F1: getGroupIdsWithViewPermission` passes and collects `groupResource.getId()` (a random resource UUID, while the group ID is the resource name), so the set never holds group IDs and group-scoped user counts and filters break.
F2: V2 `canManage()` accepts the `VIEW` scope, so an all-groups view-only grant passes `requireManage()` in `addTopLevelGroup` and can create or move top-level groups.
F3: no-arg V2 `canView()` evaluates only the all-groups resource and returns false when no all-groups permission exists, so a one-group VIEW holder is not admitted to `/groups/count` as claimed.
